description:
The Department of the Treasury, Departmental Offices (DO), Office of International Affairs is conducting market research to determine feasibility for a potential procurement requirement.  The purpose of this notice is to obtain information from industry contractors with proven experience regarding their interest, capabilities, and recommendations to design, create, and production of the following G20 Finance Track meeting for the United States host year.

Please see attached for additional information.

3/2/2026 - The purpose of this Amendment #1 is to correct a typo on page 1 from May 14-14, 2026 to May 14-15, 2026, revised RFI dated 3/2/2026 attached.
